text:
Sweet chopo,
sweet chopo,
you has puesto
of oro.
Yesterday estabas green,
a green mad
of birds
gloriosos.
Today estás abatido
bajo the sky of August
as I bajo the sky
of my espíritu red.
The fragancia cautiva
of your tronco
will come to my heart
piadoso.
¡Rudo abuelo of the prado!
Nosotros
us hemos puesto
of oro.

translation.title: "In memoriam"
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
